subject: general
question: Which nutrient is chlorella rich in?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Protein**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Chlorella__

 __
 
• Chlorella (green algae) is known as the Space algae and is used in space research.
 
• It serves as a good source of food for humans in space as it contains a high level of iron, vitamins and amino acids.
 
• It grows easily in the presence of sunlight, minerals and water and using hydroponics.
 
 
 
• **Protein**
 
 
• Although **protein** is a necessary macronutrient, not all protein-rich foods are made **equal**, and you may not require as much as you might believe.
 
• Discover the **fundamentals **of **protein** and how to incorporate** wholesome protein** meals into your **diet**.
 
• The body is made up of **protein**, which may be found in almost every **organ**, **tissue**, and** body part**, including **muscle**, **bone**, **skin**, and **hair**.
 
• It contributes to the **production **of **haemoglobin**, which transports **oxygen **in the **blood**, and **enzymes**, which drive numerous** chemical reactions**. You are made up of at least **10,000 distinct proteins**, which also keep you that way.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amino acids** are the more than **twenty fundamental building components **used to make **protein**.
 
• Since we cannot store **amino acids**, our systems must either create them from **scratch **or **alter **existing ones.
 
• Nine **amino acids**, known as the essential amino acids, must be obtained from **food**: **histidine**, **isoleucine**, **leucine**, **lysine**, **methionine**, **phenylalanine**, **threonine**, **tryptophan**, and **valine**.
